_note: Answer key. Never copy this into demo-app/. Lines are inclusive ranges in the shipped demo-app. 'marker' is text that must appear inside the range; the smoke test uses it to catch drift after edits. v2: decoys D2/D3 replaced after the pilot showed the old ones had real issues.

bugs.what: Discount uses > instead of >=, so an order of exactly $100.00 gets no discount
paginate drops the last item of every full page (page_size - 1)
Tax is charged on the pre-discount subtotal, docstring says discounted amount
SQL injection: username interpolated into query
Path traversal: filename joined without sanitising
One database query per SKU inside a loop
List membership check makes dedupe quadratic
Page-size test passes even when pages are short (<= instead of ==)

decoys.why_fine: f-string table name is checked against a whitelist first
Integer division on cents is intentional; negative amounts are handled by taking the sign first
basename strips any directory part, so path traversal is not possible here
